rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software aligns directly with Sharon's work on production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai. As someone building the developer platform (Expo) that could serve as a launchpad for this new wave of AI-enabled builders, Charlie's perspective on iteration speed and lowering barriers to shipping could inform Sharon's infrastructure work across biotech, healthtech, and fintech verticals.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Sharon — you're both positioned at the intersection of democratizing software development and AI: Charlie through Expo's vision of AI expanding who can build, and Sharon through TheAgentic.Ai's production-ready agent infrastructure for specialized domains.
